description: This file defines a React functional component for an administrator dashboard interface in a web application. It allows users to create new products and view existing products with a set of form inputs and product cards. The component interacts with external API endpoints for product creation and retrieval, and manages internal state for form inputs, errors, and success messages.

methods.name: AdminDashboard()
methods.description: Main React component for the admin dashboard page, managing product creation and display.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating a new product, interacts with the API, updates UI based on success or error.
